headline: Strongpoints Shift Hands as War 140 Enters Day 194
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Stlican Shelf again dominates the wires: forty-three strategic-base events in the past day, seven in the last two hours, with Breaker Town the busiest strongpoint. Godcrofts also keeps flashing, logging four events in two hours, while DeadLands has come alive at the latest cutoff, with Callahan's Gate and the Salt March among the active points. Stonecradle and Callahan's Passage continue to trade strongpoints, both reporting accelerated casualties on each side. The Weathered Expanse still carries the largest twenty-four-hour ledger, fifty-six events, but has not posted a fresh strategic-base change since mid-afternoon; Linn Mercy has likewise gone quiet on base ownership despite heavy casualty totals in the last two hours. Elsewhere, many hexes remain fixed single-faction holdings with only enlistment and light skirmish returns. No side has yet secured the thirty-four victory towns required for decision.
